records.body: The operator started 5G Wi-Fi service on every car of Lines 1 and 2 on 21 October.
From 21 October all cars on Lines 1 and 2 carry 5G-backed Wi-Fi, the operator said.
On 21 October the ministry held a ride event on Line 2 to check the upgraded Wi-Fi with eleven citizens.
A vice minister and an eleven-member panel rode Line 2 on 21 October to test the new Wi-Fi quality.
On 23 October a lawmaker urged the ministry to extend subway 5G Wi-Fi nationwide.

cases.description: RC-38: two records agree on every exact identity fact except the stated occurrence date and nothing else establishes one occurrence; the date mismatch leaves them undecided and apart, never DISTINCT by itself.

RC-38: two reports state different dates for one occurrence; the other Evidence identifies the same specific act by the same actor (the city audit committee releasing its comprehensive audit of the Line 2 construction office, with the same 24 violations and the same named findings), so the confirmed proposal is the domain outcome despite the unresolved date.

records.body: The city audit committee released its comprehensive audit of the Line 2 construction office on 25 October, listing 24 violations, including overpaid indirect construction costs and a depot overhead line accepted without measurement.

On 26 October the city audit committee made public its comprehensive audit of the Line 2 construction office; it cites 24 violations, among them overpaid indirect construction costs and a depot overhead line accepted after only a visual check.

cases.description: RC-42: three reports of one occurrence are proposed together, but one member's citation names a sentence its record does not have. Only that member is rejected (a disclosed gap); the two grounded members still merge after confirmation.

records.body: The city council decided on 20 October to move the tram depot from the station plaza to a site on the line after surveys found a high-pressure gas main and soft ground.
Because a high-pressure gas main and weak ground lie under the station plaza, the council resolved on 20 October to relocate the planned tram depot to another plot along the route.
On 20 October councillors approved shifting the tram depot away from the station plaza, citing a gas main and soft soil found in the survey.
